name: @cinatra-ai/blog-idea-generator-agent
description: Stateless leaf agent that takes a blog brief plus optional context (audience, count, tone, existing ideas, reference content) and returns count blog post ideas with title + summary + 3-7 outline points each. Single LLM round-trip; no MCP primitives; no HITL; no web_search. Returns strict JSON {ideas:[{title,summary,outline}], notes}.
